# Yohan Chatelain

> Researcher in high-performance computing (HPC), scientific software systems, and numerical reliability. Scientific Associate at the Krembil Centre for Neuroinformatics, Centre for Addiction and Mental Health (CAMH), based in Montréal, Canada. PhD in Computer Science (Université Paris-Saclay / UVSQ, 2019).

Research topics: LLVM instrumentation, Monte Carlo and stochastic arithmetic, mixed and reduced floating-point precision, heterogeneous CPU/GPU execution, and the reproducibility and numerical stability of AI and neuroimaging pipelines. Main software: Verificarlo, Interflop, PRISM, Fuzzy PyTorch, PyTracer, VeriTracer, VPREC.

## Software and technical guides

- [Verificarlo](https://yohanchatelain.github.io/software/verificarlo/): instrumentation, arithmetic models, scope, and documentation
- [Fuzzy PyTorch](https://yohanchatelain.github.io/software/fuzzy-pytorch/): stochastic arithmetic for deep learning
- [PyTracer](https://yohanchatelain.github.io/software/pytracer/): Python numerical-variability profiling
- [Python numerical instability](https://yohanchatelain.github.io/guides/numerical-instability-python/): conditioning, cancellation, executed examples
- [Monte Carlo arithmetic and stochastic rounding](https://yohanchatelain.github.io/guides/monte-carlo-arithmetic-stochastic-rounding/): definitions and probability models
- [Numerical variability in neuroimaging](https://yohanchatelain.github.io/guides/numerical-variability-neuroimaging/): variance models and synthetic examples
